facts.value: Consumes boss HSD_GObj and Fighter state, stage floor bounds, the global active-fighter list, opponent positions, player-slot configuration, random values, and Master Hand extended attributes. It writes fighter position, facing, rotation, and self-velocity; returns fighter objects, motion IDs, status predicates, and attribute values; and dispatches audio, player, item, and camera operations used by Hand-boss controllers.

facts.value: The unit has no module-owned progression state. Commands mutate supplied Fighter objects or call player, item and camera services. Kind lookup returns NULL when absent; motion lookup returns ftCo_MS_DeadDown. Hand predicates return false for absent fighters, the Crazy Hand x2250 accessor and CPU-selected attribute helper return 0, and five Master Hand attribute accessors return -1 when the attribute lookup fails. These are sentinels, not a guarantee that all helpers tolerate missing input objects.
